title: Brain criticality predicts individual levels of inter-areal synchronization (Fusca, Siebenhuehner, Wang et al., 2023): SEEG/MEG PLV and DFA (derivative)
description: This derivative dataset repackages the authors' public Dryad release of phase-synchronization and detrended fluctuation analysis (DFA) results computed from resting-state SEEG (68 drug-resistant focal epilepsy patients) and MEG (52 healthy subjects, 192 sessions). It includes per-patient complex phase-locking value matrices, DFA exponents, and contact masks, along with group-level MEG and simulated hierarchical Kuramoto model data. The data support the finding that brain criticality predicts individual levels of inter-areal synchronization. Raw recordings are not included.
methods_description: SEEG: 10 min of eyes-closed resting state recorded monopolarly at Niguarda Hospital, Milan. Epileptic-artifact windows were rejected, contacts were referenced to the closest white matter, and data were filtered with an FIR broadband filter and 50 Hz notch filters. Phase-locking value and DFA exponents were computed with 24 Morlet wavelets (2-225 Hz). MEG: eyes-open resting-state sessions recorded with a 306-channel Vectorview/Triux system, processed with tSSS and ICA, source-reconstructed to the 400-parcel Schaefer atlas, and analyzed with wPLI and DFA. Simulations used hierarchical Kuramoto models.
